user.title: Connect to a Ctrlmate PC
user.description: Enter the address of the computer running Ctrlmate. Discovery normally finds it automatically.

data_description.host: IPv4, IPv6 or host name of the PC.

confirm_fingerprint.title: Confirm the certificate of {name}
confirm_fingerprint.description:
Ctrlmate on {host} presented this certificate fingerprint (SHA-256):

`{fingerprint}`

Open the Ctrlmate desktop app on that PC, go to the Home Assistant page and compare it with the fingerprint shown there. Only continue if they are identical. Home Assistant will refuse any other certificate from now on.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: In the Ctrlmate desktop app on {name} ({host}), open the Home Assistant page, click Start pairing and enter the 6-digit PIN shown there.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant can no longer sign in to Ctrlmate on {host}: the pairing was revoked or the certificate changed. Continue to pair again with a new PIN.

reconfigure.title: Change the address of the Ctrlmate PC
reconfigure.description: Update where Home Assistant reaches this PC. The pairing and the pinned certificate are kept when the certificate is unchanged.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Ctrlmate at this address. Check that the PC is on, Ctrlmate is running and the firewall allows the port.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN is invalid or expired. Start a new pairing in the desktop app.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong PIN attempts. Wait a moment and start a new pairing.
error.fingerprint_not_confirmed: Confirm that the fingerprints are identical to continue.
error.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different PC than the one configured.

abort.already_configured: This Ctrlmate PC is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Ctrlmate on this PC.
abort.not_ctrlmate_device: The discovered device is not a valid Ctrlmate PC.
abort.fingerprint_mismatch: The certificate presented by the PC does not match the fingerprint it advertises or the pinned one. Nothing was paired. Make sure you are on a trusted network and try again.
abort.wrong_device: This is a different PC than the one that was paired.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Ctrlmate PC address was updated.

init.title: Wake-on-LAN
init.description: Settings used by the Wake PC button.

data_description.wol_broadcast_address: Leave empty to use the broadcast address of the PC's subnet.

error.invalid_broadcast: Enter a valid IPv4 broadcast address.

auth_failed.message: Ctrlmate rejected the stored pairing. Re-authenticate the integration.

connection_lost.message: The connection to {name} was lost before the command finished.

command_permission_denied.message: This action is disabled in the Ctrlmate permissions of {name}.

command_no_agent.message: The Ctrlmate agent is not running in the user session of {name}, so this action cannot run.

command_agent_timeout.message: The Ctrlmate agent on {name} did not answer in time.

command_hardware_error.message: The hardware of {name} reported an error: {message}

command_busy.message: {name} is busy, try again in a moment.

command_unavailable.message: This function is currently unavailable on {name}.

wol_no_mac.message: The MAC address of {name} is not known yet. Connect it once so it can be learned.

wol_invalid_address.message: The Wake-on-LAN broadcast address {address} is not a valid IPv4 address.

no_agent.title: Ctrlmate agent is not running on {name}
no_agent.description: {name} refused an action because the Ctrlmate agent (the part that runs in the signed-in user session) is not connected. Lock, display, volume and notification actions need it. Sign in on the PC and make sure Ctrlmate Agent starts at login.

service_outdated.title: Ctrlmate on {name} is outdated
service_outdated.description: {name} runs Ctrlmate {version} but this integration needs at least {required}. Some entities or error messages may be missing. Update Ctrlmate on the PC.
